[[Captain Osric]] has tasked you with finding the perfect birthday gift for [[Prince Rurik]]'s betrothed, [[Lady Althea]]. Search [[Lakeside County]] for three appropriately beautiful items.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
}}
* [[Charr at the Gate]] not active
* Prince Rurik and Captain Osric have finished conversing

===Objectives===
* Find the perfect gift for Lady Althea. It must be something beautiful.
* Give the [[Beautiful Feather]] to Captain Osric.
* Give the [[Beautiful Pearl]] to Captain Osric.
* Give the [[Beautiful Pendant]] to Captain Osric.
* Return to Captain Osric for your reward.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Inscribed Chakram (metal)|Inscribed Chakram]] 
** [[Energy]] +3
** [[Armor rating|Armor]] +5 (while [[Hexed]])
** Energy +7 (while Hexed)

===Environmental changes===
* Upon accepting the quest, Prince Rurik will no longer spawn next to the city walls with Captain Osric.

==Walkthrough==
To trigger the quest, first listen to a [[Lakeside County#Rurik and Osric|conversation]] between Prince Rurik and Captain Osric that takes place just west of the [[Ascalon City (pre-Searing)|Ascalon City]] portal, on the path toward the [[Althea's Actors Stage|Actors' Stage]]. When they finish, talk to Osric to accept the quest. You can collect all of the three ''beautiful'' items at any time.

All three items are located in Lakeside County:
* The  [[Beautiful Feather]] can be found on a fenced-in hill in the center of [[Ashford]].
* The [[Beautiful Pearl]] is hidden inside a [[Beautiful Shell]] near the watermill.
* The [[Beautiful Pendant]] is in a [[Chest (Lakeside County)|chest]] in a mountain pass, northeast of the [[bandit]] camp above [[Ashford Abbey]].

There are two ways to complete the quest, neither of which alters the storyline:

* '''Collect all three items:''': Obtain all three items and return to Captain Osric. No matter the order you present them, he will fuss over and reject the first two before finally accepting the third, granting your reward. Regardless of the order you present them, he will reject the first two and select the third as the gift, allowing you to conclude the quest and obtain the reward. ''Or...''
* '''Speak with Althea:''' Collect any one of the items, then speak to Lady Althea in front of the Actors' Stage. She will accept the single ''beautiful'' item, concluding the quest and granting you the reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Captain Osric
:''"I have a very important mission for you, <Character name>. The prince's love, Althea, will celebrate her birthday tomorrow. The prince has charged me with finding the '''perfect gift''', one that is as unique and beautiful as Althea herself. What do you say? Can you help me?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I think I can handle that.

}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Captain Osric
:''"Have you found the '''perfect gift''' yet? Remember: Like Lady Althea, it must be beautiful."''
::'''⇒ Give Beautiful Feather'''
::''"This is a magnificent feather. One could probably fashion an exquisite writing quill from it, but I believe we need something a bit more regal for our Lady. Please keep looking."''
::'''⇒ Give Beautiful Pearl'''
::''"A pearl? Simple, elegant...but Lady Althea must have something unique and more personal. Please keep looking."''
::'''⇒ Give Beautiful Pendant'''
::''"This is a magnificent piece of jewelry, however, I believe we need something a little less...worn to present to our Lady. Please keep looking."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Captain Osric
:''"Wherever did you find this, {{sic}} <Beautiful item>? Yes, this is the perfect gift for Althea! Prince Rurik will be delighted. I'll make sure he knows of your involvement in obtaining the one thing that is sure to please his lady."''
or
;Lady Althea
:''"What's this? Does Rurik think I care one whit what gift he gives me? What matters is that a gift comes from the heart. That he choose it himself is all I ask. You can put an end to this nonsense at once. I'll have a talk with Osric and Rurik myself!"''

==Notes==
* If you are carrying more than one of the items, Lady Althea will take all of them when completing the quest.
* Having Charr at the Gate active means the Beautiful Feather, the chest holding the Beautiful Pendant, and the Beautiful Shell do not spawn. Otherwise, even without A Gift for Althea active, all 3 will spawn.
* Similarly, having Charr at the Gate active makes it impossible to initiate this quest, since Osric and Rurik will not initiate their conversation about Althea. You can begin the quest once you [[Zone#Zoning and rezoning|re-zone]] and talk to Osric.
{{anomaly|Captain Osric's appearance and weapon during his conversation with Prince Rurik differ from those he has when he accepts the quest items.}}
